notes.title: Achievements added!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We've published an update of the game that includes:
[list]
[*] minor bug fixes
[*] typos and translation corrections
[*] But most important of all -> The game now has steam achievements!
[/list]

Have fun unlocking them!

PS: some of them are a bit tricky, so if you get stuck, write in the discussion forum and we'll try to point you in the right direction :)
